title: The Pervasive Blind Spot: Benchmarking VLM Inference Risks on Everyday Personal Videos

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating VLM inference accuracy and self-reported explanations on everyday personal videos to identify the visual cues, topics (e.g., 'Fashion'), and cinematic styles models use as stereotyped indicators to infer a user's gender.

Analyzing model inferences, chain-of-thought reasoning, and object ablation on personal videos to determine how VLMs correlate specific environmental objects, filming behaviors (e.g., smartphone panning), and video topics with the user's age bracket.

Assessing how VLMs infer socioeconomic attributes (income, education level, and occupation) by conducting object ablation studies and analyzing model explanations to reveal algorithmic stereotyping based on ambient objects (e.g., TVs, laptops, books) and video locations.
